response.original_title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic Pony Trick or Treat
response.overview: Get ready for a collection of spooky episodes that are sure to bring out the Boos and Ahhhs! Twilight Sparkle and her best friend - Spike, Applejack, Pinkie Pie, Rainbow Dash, Rarity, and Fluttershy - experience spine-tingling adventures with zoom-ponies, a changeling with a bad attitude, and a trip to rescue a magic icon.
